oneLine: Schaeffler India promoter group is considering monetising a small part of their shareholding.

sources.title: Schaeffler India : Promoter group mulls monetising a small part of shareholding

synopsis: The promoter group of Schaeffler India Limited is considering monetising a small part of its shareholding, according to a regulatory filing with the National Stock Exchange. The promoter group currently holds 74.13 percent of the paid-up share capital. Despite the contemplated monetisation, the group stated it will remain the significant majority shareholder, maintaining at least two-thirds of the company's outstanding shares. The communication was described as an expression of intent rather than a definitive obligation, supported by Schaeffler AG's CEO Klaus Rosenfeld and Head of M&A Dr. Christopher Köth.
